ta: ta — then, when, so that; particle introducing a following clause, also marks wishes/purpose
xqui: xki — they (did it); x- completive + ki- 3pl ergative, prefix before a transitive verb
nohih: nojij — think of, conceive; transitive verb
chic: chik — now, already, also; adverb of changed state
re: re — of, belonging to; relational particle
ronohel: ronojel — all, everything; quantifier, r- + onojel
ri: ri — the, that (definite article/relative marker, e.g. ri Tepew 'the Sovereign'); particle
caam: k'a'm — vine, creeper; noun, paired with che' 'tree'
alom: Alom — Child-Bearer; from al 'a woman's child'; title of a creator, paired with K'ajolom
ꜭaholom: K'ajolom — Son-Begetter; from k'ajol 'a man's son'; title of a creator, paired with Alom
chi: chi — at, in, to; preposition (also optative 'let' before a verb)
xeꜭha: xech'a — they spoke; x- completive + e- 'they' + ch'a(w) 'speak'
cut: k'ut — then, and so; narrative connective particle
ꜩihoh: tzijoj — they told / tell; root tzij 'word' + -oj verbalizer
puch: puch — also, and; particle tagging the second of a pair
cu: k'u — then, so; narrative connective, variant of k'ut
xvinaquir: xwinaqir — it came into being; x- completive + winaqir 'come into being'
vi: wi — there, here, in it; locative particle (points back to a place or time)
xe: xe — they; x- completive + e 'they', before an intransitive verb (xe na'ojinik 'they pondered'); also xe' 'root' in the title line
vchaxic: uchaxik — its being called; u- 'its' + cha 'say' + passive -x + -ik
quix: kix — you all (with an ongoing/commanded action); k- + ix 'you (pl.)'
vleu: ulew — earth, land; noun; u- here part of the word, not 'its'
ry: ri — the, that (spelled ry by Ximénez); particle, same as ri
rumal: rumal — by, because of, through; relational noun r- 'its' + umal 'cause, agent'
ꜯacol: Tz'aqol — Builder; agent noun root tz'aq 'build' + -ol, name
bitol: B'itol — Shaper; agent noun b'it 'shape' + -ol; title of a creator
tah: taj — let it be, may it; Classical optative particle (in modern K'iche' taj is a negative)
huracan: Juraqan — Huracan; name of the Heart of Sky, meaning disputed ('one leg'? per Ximénez)
chipi: ch'ipi — youngest, smallest; adjective, part of a name
caculha: Kaqulja — Thunderbolt, lightning; part of Juraqan's names; kaqulja 'lightning'
raxa: raxa — green-blue, fresh; adjective in names (Raxa Kaqulja)
vꜭux: Uk'u'x — its heart; u- 'its' + k'u'x 'heart, centre'; in Uk'u'x Kaj 'Heart of Sky'
cah: kaj — sky (also 'four' in the cord passage); noun
vleuh: ulew — earth, land; noun, spelled with a final h by Ximénez
que: ke — thus, as; adverb of manner
vvach: uwach — its face; u- 'its' + wach 'face, surface', possessed noun
quib: kib' — themselves, one another; ki- 'their' + -ib' reflexive
pu: pu — also, and; short form of puch
ꜭo: k'o — there is, exists; existential verb
ban: b'an — do, make; root of the verb, here with x- completive and ki- 3pl: 'they did'
chuxoc: chuxoq — let it be; ch- optative + ux 'become' + -oq
are: are — this is, it is; demonstrative/copula pointing forward
xbanatah: xb'anataj — it was done; x- completive + b'an 'do' + passive -aj (-ataj)
ꜯac: tz'aq — built, construction; root tz'aq 'build' (a wall); as in qatz'aq 'our built'
bit: b'it — shape, mould (as clay); root of B'itol, here in winaq b'it 'a shaped person'
cumal: kumal — by them; r- 'by' form rumal with 3pl ki-
ꜩucul: tzuqul — provider; agent noun? root tzuq 'provide' (uncertain)
cool: k'o'l — sustainer (uncertain); agent noun, paired with tzuqul 'provider'
chirech: chirech — about it, of it; chi + rech 'of, belonging to it'
mahabi: majab'i — there is not, not yet; negative particle
xecha: xecha — they said; x- completive + e- 'they' + cha 'say'
naohih: na'ojij — plan, think out; na'oj 'thought' + -ij transitive verb
xpiyacoc: Xpiyakok — name of the grandfather creator; meaning uncertain, x- prefix
xmucane: Xmukane — name of the grandmother creator; meaning uncertain, x- feminine prefix
hunahpu: Junajpu — Hunahpu; name, also a day in the calendar; meaning uncertain
vuch: Wuch' — opossum; noun, part of the name Junajpu Wuch' 'Hunahpu Opossum'
vtiu: Utiw — Coyote; name element, in Junajpu Utiw 'Hunahpu Coyote' (u- here part of the name; tiw 'coyote'?)
e: e — they; plural marker before a noun or verb
zac: saq — white, light; adjective, root saq
bi: b'i' — name; noun, here 'their name' after ki 'their'
ruꜭ: ruk' — with him/it; relational noun r- 'its/his' + uk' 'company'
tepeu: Tepew — Sovereign (a title from Nahuatl); name of one of the creator gods, paired with Q'ukumatz
ꜫucumaꜩ: Q'ukumatz — Quetzal-Serpent, name of a creator god; q'uq' 'quetzal' + kumatz 'serpent'
rico: riqo — they found; root riq 'find'; xe riqo kib' 'they found each other', i.e. agreed (exact form uncertain)
iyom: Iyom — Midwife; title of Xmucane; noun in -om (uncertain derivation)
mamom: Mamom — Grandfather; mam 'grandfather' + -om; title of Xpiyacoc
cha: cha — said, say; quotative root (uncertain in this phrase 'cha ta k'ut')
chauaxoc: chawaxoq — will be sown; root chaw 'sow' + passive + -oq future
zaquiroc: saqiroq — (that) it will dawn; saqir 'dawn' + -oq subjunctive/future
